acceptanceCriteria: the fixture controls os.TempDir() on every supported GOOS, or the Unix-only scope is recorded in CEM-V1-240
body: Recorded by the #961 Codex round (P3, 2026-10-16). CEM-V1-240's refusal now compares by file identity, which also fixes Windows cross-drive paths, but the fixture sets only TMPDIR, which does not control os.TempDir() on Windows (TMP/TEMP/USERPROFILE). Latent because the stable verifier refuses non-Unix hosts. Expected: either the fixture sets the Windows variables or the spec records the Unix-only scope.
